supporting_quotes.exact: The API models the camera subsystem as a pipeline that converts incoming requests for frame captures into frames, on a 1:1 basis.

observations.subject: Camera HAL3 API
observations.object: pipeline converting incoming frame-capture requests into frames on a 1:1 basis

qualifiers.claim_segment_covered: 流水线建模与 1:1 request→frame 转换
qualifiers.claim_segment_not_covered: request 封装该帧捕获与处理所需的全部配置信息

claims.rationale: 引文 [8,49) 'models the camera subsystem as a pipeline'、[55,112) 'converts incoming requests for frame captures into frames'、[114,128) 'on a 1:1 basis' 支持'建模为流水线、request 按 1:1 转换为 frame'；但 claim 另一子命题 'request 封装该帧捕获与处理所需的全部配置信息' 在该唯一引文中无任何对应表述，无引文覆盖，故 partially_supported。区间以所给引文文本为基准。

supporting_quotes.exact: Starting with Android 13, camera HAL interface development uses AIDL. Android 8.0 introduced Treble, switching the Camera HAL API to a stable interface defined by the HAL interface description language (HIDL).

observations.subject: Camera HAL interface
observations.object: stable HIDL-defined interface since Android 8.0 (Treble); AIDL for camera HAL interface development starting with Android 13

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,69) 'Starting with Android 13, camera HAL interface development uses AIDL.' 支持'从 Android 13 起改用 AIDL'；[70,209) 'Android 8.0 introduced Treble, switching the Camera HAL API to a stable interface defined by the HAL interface description language (HIDL).' 支持'Android 8.0 引入 Treble、Camera HAL API 切换到 HIDL 定义的稳定接口'。两个子命题均被同一引文完整覆盖且相互一致，无冲突。区间以所给引文文本为基准。

supporting_quotes.exact: The HAL sits between the camera driver and the higher-level Android framework and defines an interface that you must implement so apps can correctly operate the camera hardware.
Android's camera hardware abstraction layer (HAL) connects the higher-level camera framework APIs in Camera 2 to your underlying camera driver and hardware.

observations.subject: Camera HAL
observations.object: between the camera driver and the higher-level Android framework; an interface that must be implemented so apps can correctly operate the camera hardware

observations.subject: Camera HAL
observations.object: higher-level camera framework APIs in Camera 2 to the underlying camera driver and hardware

claims.rationale: target evidence-d937f440c251 [0,77) 'The HAL sits between the camera driver and the higher-level Android framework' 支持位置关系；[81,177) 'defines an interface that you must implement so apps can correctly operate the camera hardware' 支持接口定义及用途。target evidence-8a33cfacf842 [49,155) 'connects the higher-level camera framework APIs in Camera 2 to your underlying camera driver and hardware' 支持'向上连 Camera 2 框架 API、向下连 camera driver'。两引文同源且互为印证，无冲突。区间以所给引文文本为基准。

supporting_quotes.exact: Android 9 introduced API support for multi-camera devices through a new logical camera device composed of two or more physical camera devices pointing in the same direction. The logical camera device is exposed as a single CameraDevice/CaptureSession to an app allowing for interaction with HAL-integrated multi-camera features.

observations.subject: Android 9 multi-camera API
observations.object: logical camera device composed of two or more same-direction physical camera devices, exposed to apps as a single CameraDevice/CaptureSession

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,173) 'Android 9 introduced API support for multi-camera devices through a new logical camera device composed of two or more physical camera devices pointing in the same direction' 支持'Android 9 引入、由两个及以上指向同方向的物理摄像头组成逻辑设备'；[174,260) 'The logical camera device is exposed as a single CameraDevice/CaptureSession to an app' 支持'对应用呈现为单个 CameraDevice/CaptureSession'。完整覆盖、一致无冲突。区间以所给引文文本为基准。

supporting_quotes.exact: Most of this information is a static property of the camera subsystem and can therefore be queried before configuring any output pipelines or submitting any requests.

the new camera API adds a substantial amount of dynamic metadata to each captured frame. This includes the requested and actual parameters used for the capture, as well as additional per-frame metadata such as timestamps and statistics generator output.
For most settings, the expectation is that they can be changed every frame, without introducing significant stutter or delay to the output frame stream.

observations.subject: static camera metadata
observations.object: static property of the camera subsystem, queryable before configuring output pipelines or submitting requests

qualifiers.includes: requested and actual parameters used for the capture, per-frame metadata such as timestamps and statistics generator output

observations.subject: most camera settings
observations.object: every frame without introducing significant stutter or delay to the output frame stream

claims.rationale: static：引文1 [28,69) 'a static property of the camera subsystem'、[73,165) 'can therefore be queried before configuring any output pipelines or submitting any requests' 支持该段；dynamic：引文2 [19,87) 'adds a substantial amount of dynamic metadata to each captured frame'、[88,159) 'This includes the requested and actual parameters used for the capture'、[183,220) 'per-frame metadata such as timestamps' 支持随帧生成、含实际参数与时间戳；control：引文3 [0,74)、[75,151) 支持'可每帧修改、无明显卡顿或延迟'。但三引文均无'分三类'的显式枚举，'曝光时间、帧时长、灵敏度'等具体参数名未在任何引文区间出现，引文3亦未使用 'control' 术语（仅 'most settings'）。故 partially_supported。区间以所给引文文本为基准。

supporting_quotes.exact: A hardware abstraction layer (HAL) is type of abstraction layer with a standard interface for hardware vendors to implement. A HAL allows hardware vendors to implement lower-level, device-specific features without affecting or modifying code in higher-level layers.
HIDL enables communication between HAL clients and HAL services.

observations.subject: HAL
observations.object: abstraction layer with a standard interface for hardware vendors to implement

qualifiers.allows: lower-level, device-specific features without affecting or modifying code in higher-level layers

claims.rationale: 引文1 [0,124) 'A hardware abstraction layer (HAL) is type of abstraction layer with a standard interface for hardware vendors to implement.' 支持标准接口抽象层；[125,264) 'A HAL allows hardware vendors to implement lower-level, device-specific features without affecting or modifying code in higher-level layers.' 支持实现底层设备特定功能且不影响更高层代码。引文2 [0,63) 'HIDL enables communication between HAL clients and HAL services' 支持 HIDL 通信用途。全部子命题被覆盖、两引文同源一致无冲突。区间以所给引文文本为基准。

supporting_quotes.exact: Most tests in VTS are GTest-style tests that check the HAL implementation.

observations.subject: Most tests in VTS
observations.object: GTest-style tests that check the HAL implementation

qualifiers.not_covered: 也覆盖 Linux kernel 测试

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,73) 'Most tests in VTS are GTest-style tests that check the HAL implementation' 支持'大多数测试为检查 HAL 实现的 GTest 风格测试'；但 claim 中'也覆盖 Linux kernel 测试'在该唯一 target 引文全文 [0,74) 内无任何对应表述，缺少相应证据，故 partially_supported。区间以所给引文文本为基准。

supporting_quotes.exact: hardware devices are modelled as an oriented graph of building blocks called entities connected through pads.

An entity is a basic media hardware building block. It can correspond to a large variety of logical blocks such as physical hardware devices (CMOS sensor for instance), logical hardware devices (a building block in a System-on-Chip image processing pipeline), DMA channels or physical connectors.

observations.subject: media controller model
observations.object: oriented graph of building blocks called entities connected through pads

qualifiers.can_correspond_to: physical hardware devices (CMOS sensor), logical hardware devices (building block in a System-on-Chip image processing pipeline), DMA channels, physical connectors

claims.rationale: 引文1 [0,108) 'hardware devices are modelled as an oriented graph of building blocks called entities connected through pads' 支持'entity 图、经 pad 连接'；引文2 [0,50) 'An entity is a basic media hardware building block' 支持基本构建块；[51,295) 列举 'physical hardware devices (CMOS sensor for instance), logical hardware devices (a building block in a System-on-Chip image processing pipeline), DMA channels or physical connectors' 支持对应 CMOS sensor、SoC 图像处理流水线、DMA 通道等。完整覆盖、同源一致无冲突。区间以所给引文文本为基准。
